نتواجد (form VI)
# نَتَوَاجَدُ (natawājadu) /na.ta.waː.d͡ʒa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاجَدَ (tawājada)
# نَتَوَاجَدَ (natawājada) /na.ta.waː.d͡ʒa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاجَدَ (tawājada)
# نَتَوَاجَدْ (natawājad) /na.ta.waː.d͡ʒad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاجَدَ (tawājada)
